title: Naval intelligence commander's email: UAP enter and leave the ocean in five to seven areas
summary: Tim Gallaudet tells of Naval intelligence commander's email: UAP enter and leave the ocean in five to seven areas, about unspecified at World oceans; unidentified compartmented network, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: these objects all the we see them in the ocean more than more than elsewhere coming in and out of the ocean and they seem to be occurring in five to seven areas of the world.
Undersea bases possibly, right? We know five to seven locations.

tellings.link_reason: The five to seven ocean locations come from the naval intelligence email about UAP entering and leaving the ocean in five to seven areas.
